storefront.heroDescription: Browse fresh groceries, pantry staples, and local favorites from trusted shops near you.
storefront.footerDescription: Everyday essentials from local shops, ready for delivery.
storefront.searchDescription: Search local essentials or narrow the shelves by category.
storefront.noCategoryProducts: There are no available products in this category yet.
storefront.maximumInCart: Maximum available quantity is already in your cart

landing.heroDescription: Browse products from local shops, place an order with a saved delivery address, and follow its progress. Shop owners, delivery personnel, and administrators each have a workspace for their part.
landing.overviewDescription: Shopping, shop management, and delivery stay connected in one application.
landing.overviewStorefrontDescription: Find products by category and browse what shops have available.
landing.overviewRolesDescription: Customers, owners, delivery personnel, and admins see tools for their responsibilities.
landing.overviewLanguagesDescription: Use the storefront and workspaces in your preferred language.
landing.overviewPaymentDescription: Review your order total at checkout and pay when it arrives.
landing.featuresTitle: The right tools for every role
landing.featuresDescription: Each workspace supports a real step in the shopping and delivery process.
landing.customerDescription: Browse products, manage your cart and addresses, place orders, and review order history.
landing.ownerDescription: Manage products, stock, incoming orders, delivery staff, shop settings, and reports.
landing.deliveryDescription: Select ready orders, organize delivery batches, arrange stops, and record delivery results.
landing.adminDescription: Manage users and shops, create delivery accounts, and review audit activity.
landing.catalogDescription: Keep product names, prices, availability, categories, and stock up to date.
landing.ordersDescription: Confirm orders, prepare items, and mark them ready for delivery.
landing.batchesDescription: Group ready orders and set the stop sequence before starting a delivery.
landing.notificationsDescription: See relevant order status changes and notifications in your workspace.
landing.flowDescription: From checkout to delivery, the next step appears in the workspace responsible for it.
landing.flowBrowseDescription: A customer finds products, chooses a saved delivery address, and places an order.
landing.flowPrepareDescription: The shop owner reviews the order and prepares it for delivery.
landing.flowDeliverDescription: Delivery personnel add ready orders to a batch, plan stops, and record the outcome.
landing.flowTrackDescription: Customers and staff can review relevant status updates and notifications.
